offering_description.value: Thryv sells cloud software that helps small businesses manage customer relationships, automate marketing, schedule appointments, send invoices and collect payments. It delivers the software online and also helps local businesses reach customers through digital marketing and directory advertising.

primary_products.value: Customer relationship management software; marketing and sales automation software; appointment scheduling software; invoicing and payments software; online listings management software

primary_services.value: Digital and print directory advertising; search marketing; website design and hosting; payment processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small businesses, including home service contractors, professional practices, wellness providers and local retailers

end_markets.value: Home services; professional services; health and wellness; retail; other local consumer services

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud software for business management and marketing automation; advertising: Directory listings and placements in print and digital media; service fees: Website and managed search marketing services; transaction or usage fees: Processing card and electronic payments for small businesses
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines customer records, scheduling, marketing and payment workflows in cloud software for small businesses; service provider: Uses business listings and advertiser content to provide directory placements and managed marketing for local businesses

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand

specialization.value: related lines: Small-business management software, marketing automation, payments, digital marketing and directory advertising

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales representatives and business advisors serving small businesses; online: Company websites for software demos, sign-ups and subscriptions; partners / resellers: Certified consultants and agencies that refer customers and help implement marketing automation software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Customer data, marketing messages and card payments are subject to privacy laws, CAN-SPAM, TCPA and card-network standards.

notes: The current availability of legacy print directory advertising may vary by market.
